author: TadTadSauce
body: I think you accidentally banned me and didn't notice but I got banned and I couldn't join again.  I would please like to be unbanned because I love this server a lot and it makes Minecraft fun for me.  Please Unban me.

title: Please Unban me

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to deny your appeal due to lack of effort.
Feel free to submit another appeal saying why you were banned and why you deserve to be unbanned.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
